_metadata.title: FileSure CIN reference mappings
important: Mappings are reference data, not proof that a CIN exists.
An unknown code should produce an unrecognized-component result, not automatically invalidate the CIN's character structure.
State/territory entries are a conservative baseline and require cross-checking against MCA master data, including historical records.
Unverified candidates are intentionally kept separate from accepted state mappings.

OR.name: Odisha
OR.displayNote: The CIN code OR is retained; Odisha was formerly called Orissa.

FLC.label: Public limited foreign company incorporated in India
FLC.sourceMeaning: Public limited foreign company incorporated in India
FLC.note: Do not expand FLC as 'financial leasing company' based on unrelated uses of the acronym.

FTC.label: Private limited foreign company incorporated in India
FTC.sourceMeaning: Private limited foreign company incorporated in India

NPL.label: Section 25 company (historical terminology)
NPL.note: Section 25 is terminology under the former Companies Act, 1956. The Companies Act, 2013 uses Section 8 for the corresponding not-for-profit company framework. Do not assume every Section 8 company has NPL in its CIN.

OPC.label: One Person Company
OPC.note: OPC appears in a 2026 research paper's example CIN. Treat as an observed code and verify against current MCA master data before making an exhaustive claim.

TS.note: Do not silently substitute for TG; verify against MCA CIN records.

UK.note: Do not silently substitute for UT; verify against MCA CIN records.

CT.note: Do not silently substitute for CG; verify against MCA CIN records.
